A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
enzymes are the most efficient catalysts for the synthesis of complex oligosaccharide structures.
the use of enzymes for the synthesis of complex carbohydrates has reached a high level of efficiency and selectivity and the use of these biocatalysts will continue to grow in the near future.

enzymes have a huge potential in carbohydrate synthesis, thus they can be considered as the best tools in the chemist’s kit.
the use of these enzymes will be a key point in the synthesis of complex carbohydrates and glycoconjugate structures for biological applications.
